_note: Do NOT invent labels. To resolve a population request, FILTER the population catalog injected at runtime (each population carries a Region and Dataset) and output its exact `population` display labels. This file only holds the 1KGP acronym -> display-label map, which is not general knowledge. If a filter is ambiguous or matches nothing, ask.

notes.labels: select_populations needs the exact `population` display label, not an acronym. Map an acronym the user types to the catalog label (YRI -> Yoruba-1KGP) before emitting it.
notes.ancient: AADR labels encode region and age, e.g. 'aDNA West EUR 5-6 kya'.
notes.duplicate_names: A -1KGP suffix distinguishes a 1KGP population from an HGDP population of the same name (HGDP 'Yoruba' vs 1KGP 'Yoruba-1KGP'). If the user is not specific, ask which.
